recipes.title: VSCO strings: cello, viola, violin
recipes.intent: Cello, viola section and solo violin sustained notes from VSCO 2 CE (CC0, referenced, fetched on play).
recipes.code:
setcpm(60/4)
$: note("<c2 a1 f1 g1>").s("vsco_cello").gain(0.3)
$: note("<[e3,g3] [e3,a3] [f3,a3] [d3,g3]>").s("vsco_viola").gain(0.3)
$: note("<g4 e4 c5 b4>").s("vsco_violin").gain(0.3)
